title: Green Lake Pitch and Putt

services.name: Tee Times
services.desc: At Green Lake Pitch and Putt, we keep things flexible. Whether you’re a spontaneous stroller or a meticulous planner, there’s a spot for you on the green. You do not need a reservation to play! We welcome walk-in players all day, every day. Just head to the Pro Shop, grab your clubs, and we’ll get you on the course as soon as there is an opening. While walk-ins are always welcome, reserving a tee time is the best way to ensure you can play exactly when you want-especially on busy weekends and sunny afternoons. services.desc: The Short Game Social Club is a “come as you are” neighborhood outing that trades rigid golf etiquette for a laid-back lakeside hang. Designed for players looking for a neighborhood social rather than a serious round of golf, we’ve stripped away the intimidation to focus on fresh air and new friends. Whether you’re trying your very first swing or just want to trade the pavement for the grass after a lap around the lake, this is your invitation to make Green Lake Pitch & Putt your own backyard social club.
